name: Rufous-banded Owl
rangeDescription: Andes of colombia to venezuela, ecuador, peru, and bolivia
description: Uncommon medium-sized owl found in the subtropical and temperate zones of the Andes from Venezuela to Bolivia. Patterned with rufous, dark brown, and white overall.

name: Red-breasted Goose
rangeDescription: Breeds low arctic tundra of yamal, gydan, and taymyr peninsulas (northwestern siberia); winters to western and southern black sea and southern caspian sea; prone to vagrancy elsewhere in eurasia
description: Small and stocky rare goose with a small bill. From a distance, appears dark and dull, and often blends into flocks of other geese.

name: Pink-backed Pelican
rangeDescription: Locally in sub-saharan africa and madagascar
description: Small by pelican standards, though still a very large bird! Adult is mostly pale gray with a pinkish bill and (in breeding plumage) a gray crest.

name: Tufted Titmouse
rangeDescription: South-central canada (ontario) to eastern, central, and southeastern usa
description: Common backyard bird in the eastern U.S. Look for its overall gray plumage with paler underparts and orangey sides.

name: Tahiti Monarch
rangeDescription: Highlands of tahiti (society islands)
description: A distinctive large glossy-black flycatcher with a pale bluish-ivory bill. Female has a cinnamon head, a buffy chest, white underparts and brown upperparts.

name: Macquarie Shag
rangeDescription: Macquarie island and adjacent bishop and clerk rocks
description: Learn about Imperial Cormorant (Macquarie): explore photos, sounds, and observations collected by birders around the world.

name: Gray Sibia
rangeDescription: Montane forest of northeastern india, myanmar, and southern china (western yunnan)
description: Gray overall with a brown cast to the back, a dark head, and black-and-silver panels on the wings. Underparts are pale, with the throat being the whitest.

name: Western Citril
rangeDescription: Highlands of eastern democratic republic of the congo to uganda and northern zambia
description: Small seedeater with a sharp bill and forked tail. The upperparts are olive-green and the underparts pale yellow with some sparse streaking.

name: Black-throated Wren-Babbler
rangeDescription: Patchily distributed forest of borneo
description: Uncommon wren-babbler of Bornean lowland and foothill forests. Like most other wren-babblers, secretive and difficult to locate as it forages on the ground, usually in small groups.

name: Collared Palm-Thrush
rangeDescription: Coastal kenya to mozambique, caprivi strip, and southeastern angola
description: Odd and distinctive thrush. Note the gray head, pale eye, rufous back, and black mark outlining the throat.

name: Cassin's Sparrow
rangeDescription: Arid southwestern usa and adjacent northern mexico; winters to central mexico
description: Dull sparrow lacking distinctive patterns. Found in grasslands with scattered bushes.

name: Wahnes's Parotia
rangeDescription: Northeastern new guinea (northern coastal ranges of huon peninsula)
description: A large, long-tailed bird of mid-montane forest canopy on the Huon Peninsular where the only parotia. Male is mainly black with an orange patch on the forehead, bronzy-scaled chest and 6 antennalike feathers projecting from the back of the head.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Principe Sunbird
rangeDescription: Príncipe island (gulf of guinea)
description: A medium-sized dark sunbird with a graduated, white-tipped tail. Male has a blue-purple iridescent throat and upper tail; female and juvenile are dull yellow underneath.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Doria's Hawk
rangeDescription: New guinea, including and batanta (raja ampat islands, off western new guinea)
description: A large, inconspicuous raptor of lowlands and foothill forest interior. Brown back and long tail with strong barring, pale underparts with strong sparse streaking, pale eye-brow and a thick dark eye-stripe.

name: Black-breasted Kite
rangeDescription: Northern and interior plains and scrub of australia
description: A large dark raptor. In flight it shows a very short stubby tail, and has large pale wing panels.

name: Rufous-headed Robin
rangeDescription: North-central china (tsingling mountains of shaanxi and sichuan)
description: A shy ground-dwelling songbird with a highly restricted range. Male is unmistakable, with a bright rusty-orange hood and a white throat thickly bordered in black.

name: Bornean Black Magpie
rangeDescription: Borneo
description: Glossy black bird with a long tail, a heavy hooked bill, and a weak tuft of a crest. Inhabits lowland and foothill forests.

name: West Mexican Chachalaca
rangeDescription: Semiarid western mexico (central jalisco and michoacán to chiapas)
description: Noisy, long-tailed game bird of tropical forest and edge, usually found in small groups. Most often detected by its raucous song, which carries well.

name: Amazonian Elaenia
rangeDescription: Eastern colombia to eastern ecuador, northeastern peru, southern venezuela, and northwestern brazil
description: Small flycatcher of rainforest canopy. Gray male is fairly distinctive with his black wings and bold, white wingbars.

name: Mangrove Hummingbird
rangeDescription: Western coast of costa rica (gulf of nicoya to golfo dulce)
description: This restricted species is found only along the Pacific coast of Costa Rica, most often in or near mangrove trees. Medium-sized hummingbird.
